You're here. I thought someone as impatient as you would appreciate this news.
Yes. President Dayna is back from her brief absence.
strings.알다시피 데이나 총장은 길드연합의 중심이며, 폭풍의 감시자 길드 마스터이: As you know, President Dayna is the heart of the Guild Alliance and the master of the Storm Watchers Guild. It seems she's been following your exploits.
She has instructed me to test whether you qualify to enter the Guild Alliance city.
strings.시험을 치르기만 하면 저 길드 연합 병사 옆에 있는 포탈을 통해서 안으로: So once I pass, I can go inside through that portal beside the Guild Alliance soldier?
That took forever. It feels like nearly ten years.
Ten years...? Quite the sense of humor you have.
strings.시험은 별거 없어. 그저 자네의 실력으로 각종 던전을 정리하고 오면 되는: The test is nothing elaborate. You simply need to clear several dungeons using your own skills.
strings.여기 있군. 총장이 준 쪽지가…. '안식의 홀'과 '얼어붙은 세계'라는: Here it is, the note from the president... She wants you to visit the Hall of Rest and the Frozen World.
strings.(총장의 쪽지가 저절로 태워지는 걸 보니 그곳의 일이 끝났군.): (The president's note burned up on its own. That must mean the work there is finished.)
strings.힘들긴 했지만, 괜찮았어요. 시험은 이제 끝인가요?: It was tough, but I managed. Is that the end of the test?
strings.이렇게 금방 끝난다면 시험이 아니겠지?: It wouldn't be much of a test if it ended so quickly, would it?
strings.총장이 준 쪽지가 여기 더 있다. 확실하게 말하지. 여기만 다녀오면 끝이: I have another note from the president. I can promise you this: finish these places and you're done.
strings.괴물나무 산 골짜기와 마법학원 본관이군. 흐음, 어째서 마법학원이 던전: Monster Tree Mountain Valley and the Magic Academy Main Building. Hmm. Why is the academy on a list of dungeons?
Well, never mind. Take care out there.
strings.(또 쪽지가 저절로 태워지는군. 이제 끝인가…?): (Another note burning up by itself. Is that everything...?)
strings.수고했네. 이번에는 어땠나?: Well done. How did it go this time?
About the same. It was tough, but I managed.
strings.시험은 이제 끝이네. 약속대로 길드 연합 도시에 들어갈 수 있는 권한을: The test is complete. As promised, I grant you permission to enter the Guild Alliance city.
Tell Dame Lena Highren, and that settles it. You've done well.
That was simpler than I expected.
You've already completed many requests for the Guild Alliance, whether you knew it or not. That's made things easier.
I'll go tell her I'm finished, then.
strings.아직 시간이 많이 남은 것 같은데…, 맥주라도 한잔 하겠어?: Looks like there's still plenty of time... Care for a beer?
No, thank you. I have something to tell you.
strings.(데이나 총장이 낸 시험을 모두 완료해 길드 연합 도시 출입에 대한 자격: (You explain that you completed all of President Dayna's tests and now qualify to enter the Guild Alliance city.)
strings.그렇군. 며칠 뒤, 넌 정식으로 길드 연합 도시 '에스닐'로 갈 수 있을: I see. In a few days, you'll officially be allowed into Esnil, the Guild Alliance city.
strings.에스닐은 길드 연합 도시의 이면. 그걸 맞이하는 순간, 넌 또 다른 세계: Esnil is the other side of the Guild Alliance city. Once you encounter it, you'll discover another world.
While Eastland's history has been one long series of battles, Freios has always been closer to the gods. That's part of why magic flourished here.
strings.데이나 총장께선 여제 폐하와 더불어 특별하신 분이니 공손하게 대하기 바란: President Dayna is someone extraordinary, much like Her Majesty the Empress. Treat her with respect. She doesn't show herself to just anyone.
strings.대체 어떤 분이시기에 그러는 거죠?: What kind of person is she?
That's not for me to explain.
All right. I'll find out in time.
Good. Everyone should rest for now. I'll call when it's time.
You're worrying over nothing. Even Sir Muller doesn't worry about my drinking...
strings.그러고보니 폐하께서 데이나 총장을 못 본지 오래됐다고 말씀하셨는데…. 두: Come to think of it, Her Majesty said it's been a long time since she last saw President Dayna... I wonder if the two of them will meet.
